title: Semi-Conductor Sales Associate
jobDescription: Job Description Who We Are / What We Do Think Robotics.com, the e-commerce arm of Atlantis Robotics Pvt. Ltd., is a trusted source of advanced electronics and robotics components for engineers, startups, R&D labs, and enterprises across India. We empower innovation by delivering high-performance products backed by top-tier customer support and technical know-how. Whom Are We Looking For? A Semiconductor Sales Associate with a strong technical background and a passion for semiconductors, electronics, and customer engagement. You should be comfortable interacting with B2B clients, understanding complex technical requirements, and recommending semiconductor solutions that meet their project or production needs. This role is ideal for someone who blends engineering knowledge with a consultative sales approach and is looking to grow within India’s fast-evolving electronics ecosystem. Requirements Must Have · Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline · Minimum 4 years of experience in B2B sales, technical sales, or industrial/electronic component sales · Strong understanding of semiconductor products (ICs, MCUs, sensors, power devices, etc.) and their applications · Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical specs into customer-friendly solutions · Familiarity with India Mart, GEM portal, and B2B lead generation platforms Nice to Have Master’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business Interest in robotics, Io T, or embedded electronics Experience engaging with OEMs, ODMs, EMS companies, or electronics distributors Exposure to technical trade shows, industry expos, or product demo events Ability to create or interpret technical documents like RFQs, data sheets, and application notes Benefits What We Offer Salary: ₹40,000–₹50,000/month ( negotiable for candidates with exceptional experience and technical expertise ) A chance to work at the forefront of robotics and electronics innovation Opportunities to grow into strategic and leadership roles A collaborative, learning-focused, and impact-driven work environment I'm interested View all jobs Visit website Privacy Terms of Service Powered by {{criteria Index}} {{field}} {{captialize(condition)}} ( ) {{cx Prop Help Text}} {{cx Prop Field.consent_details.description}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{candidate.Email}} {{top Message}} Job Details {{top Message}} previous next {{title}} {{score}}% Job Description {{unescape(sanitize HTML(description HTML))}} {{message}} Step {{cur Step In Mandatory Sec Prompt}}/{{total Num Of Steps In Mandatory Sec Prompt}} For privacy and security purposes, please go through the following points and provide consent. title: Manager – Sales
jobDescription:
Job Description Job Title: Manager – Sales Who We Are / What We Do Think Robotics.com, the e-commerce division of Atlantis Robotics Pvt. Ltd., provides advanced robotics and electronic components to innovators and businesses across India. We focus on delivering high-quality products with exceptional customer support. Whom Are We Looking For? We are seeking a results-driven and strategically oriented Manager – Technical Sales to lead and scale our B2B technical sales function. This role requires a strong blend of engineering expertise, business acumen, and leadership capability to drive revenue growth, build strategic accounts, and lead a high-performing technical sales team. Requirements Must Have Master’s degree in Engineering and/or MBA (Marketing / Tech Management) Minimum 7–10 years of experience in technical/B2B or industrial sales At least 4 years of experience leading a sales or application engineering team Strong exposure to robotics, Io T, automation, electronics, or prototyping platforms Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets Experience handling enterprise accounts and high-value negotiations Experience participating in industry exhibitions and technical expos Nice to Have · Experience in scaling a technical sales team in a growth-stage company · Exposure to export/international B2B sales · Technical certifications in robotics, Io T, or automation platforms · Strong industry network within engineering institutes or industrial clients Benefits What We Offer Competitive salary (based on experience and performance) A chance to work at the forefront of robotics and electronics innovation Opportunities to grow into strategic and leadership roles A collaborative, learning-focused, and impact-driven work environment Salary: 50,000
- 65,000 INR / month based on qualification and experience + sales-based commissions.
